description: Build a junior Astronaut Mission Trainer
summary: Mars Survival Base is a simple survival decision-based game where the player makes choices at the start of each period to gain resources, which they need to survive and repair the 5 different broken systems in their Mars base.
details: The game provides a fun and interactive way for youth to learn more about how life survives in space. The resources used are relevant to the real-life needs of an astronaut to survive in space. Fixing the different systems provides fun facts about Mars and astronaut life during a Mars expedition/outpost, based on NASA data. The game aims to provide an enjoyable yet educational experience for children. The game was made using the Godot engine and the associated GDScript programming language.
